claim: Patchline quantifies how much each analysis stage actually contributes by ablating one stage at a time and measuring the resulting drop in accuracy, so the pipeline can be justified stage by stage instead of asserted as a monolith. The worker computes the marginal contribution of every stage as the full-pipeline accuracy minus the accuracy with that stage removed, identifies load-bearing stages with a positive marginal, and flags redundant stages whose removal changes nothing. The gate proves the key taint and backfill stages have strictly positive marginal contributions while a redundant duplicate stage contributes zero.
